design.mile_wide_inch_deep: All 295 conditions accounted per dealer at shallow depth (state + reason), so nothing is silently dropped.
design.mile_deep_inch_wide: The few accepted-runnable conditions (SW-032/SW-041) are computed to full lineage/numerator/denominator depth.
design.consultant_synthesis: Cross-cluster rules join clusters into automotive-sales-consultant diagnoses, gated by compatibility controls; not a per-metric dashboard narration.

compatibility_controls.same_dealer: Both operands must be the SAME dealer/rooftop.
compatibility_controls.accepted_source_only: A composite may combine ONLY accepted (non-quarantined) sources; a quarantined ROI/CAGE/Comm operand makes the composite provisional/blocked, never accepted.
compatibility_controls.compatible_population_period_grain_unit_: Operands must share compatible population, period, grain, unit, and denominator; mismatched denominators/periods block the composite.
compatibility_controls.insufficient_history_blocks_trends: Any trend/WoW/trailing operand is blocked until ≥2–4 governed periods accrue.
compatibility_controls.unstable_ids_block_ordered_causal_comm: Sales-Communication lacks stable thread IDs; ordered/causal comm claims are blocked.
compatibility_controls.source_disagreement_blocks_composites: If two sources disagree for the same measure (e.g. Ford CRM gross 7 rows vs Dashboard 6 sold), the composite is blocked and both values are shown unreconciled.
compatibility_controls.never_zero: Missing / stale / quarantined / zero-denominator is NEVER treated as zero.

cross_cluster_rules.name: Intake-to-response leak
cross_cluster_rules.hypothesis: High lead volume + slow/absent first response + low appointment-set ⇒ intake→response process leak.

cross_cluster_rules.name: Throughput vs pricing
cross_cluster_rules.hypothesis: High gross/deal + low sold-volume ⇒ desking/throughput tradeoff.

cross_cluster_rules.name: Template relevance
cross_cluster_rules.hypothesis: High outbound + low inbound + low appointment ⇒ messaging relevance problem.

cross_cluster_rules.name: Appointment execution
cross_cluster_rules.hypothesis: Low show rate + high no-show ⇒ appointment execution gap (SW-032/SW-041 accepted).

cross_cluster_rules.name: Source-hygiene expense waste
cross_cluster_rules.hypothesis: High duplicate-lead rate + unknown spend ⇒ source-hygiene + expense-reduction flag.

service_note: Service is NOT a Sales cluster; service_domain_out_of_sales routes ONLY to the separate Serra Service workspace.
